newsitem.title: FRANCE: French police say suspects confess to girls murder.
newsitem.headline: French police say suspects confess to girls murder.

text.p: French police said on Friday that suspects had confessed to the murder of four young women who went missing during a carnival evening 10 days ago in the northern port of Boulogne.
Investigators said a search for the bodies was under way in a forest outside the village of Portel, near Boulogne.
"This is ending in tragedy," a police officer said.
The four young women -- 20 year-olds Isabelle and Peggy, and 17-year-olds Audrey and Amelie -- were allegedly murdered on the evening following their disappearance, police said.
Five members of the same family were detained by police on Thursday in the case.
The suspects include three brothers, all of them scrap merchants, who live in a village a few km (miles) from the spot where the women were seen for the last time, police said.
